changes_made.explanation: Changed answer from Yes to No because this paper focuses on sarcasm detection (NLU task), not natural language generation. Removed all metadata as the paper uses image captioning models only as feature extractors for classification, not for evaluating NLG outputs.
Removed Accuracy and F1-score as these are classification metrics used to evaluate sarcasm detection performance, not metrics for evaluating generated language outputs.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper.
No human evaluation of generated outputs was conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper is about multi-modal sarcasm detection (classification task), not natural language generation evaluation. While it uses NLG models like GPT-2 and CLIP for feature extraction, it does not evaluate their generation capabilities. The extracted metadata mistakenly identified this as an NLG evaluation paper.
